name: The Village Of Bees Creek
summary: The Village of Bees Creek is a well-regarded community shopping center serving the upscale Sienna Plantation area of Missouri City, Texas. With convenient hours and a strong tenant mix, it serves as a primary retail destination for one of the Houston area's most desirable master-planned communities.
demographics: The Village of Bees Creek serves the affluent Sienna Plantation master-planned community in Missouri City, attracting primarily upper-middle-class families with household incomes exceeding $100,000. The trade area demographics skew toward young professionals and families with children, aged 30-55, who value convenience and quality in their shopping experience. Visitors typically engage in weekly grocery shopping combined with service-oriented errands, favoring national retailers and dining options that cater to family-friendly environments and busy lifestyles.
description: The Village of Bees Creek is a premier community shopping center located at 4225 Sienna Parkway in the heart of Missouri City's rapidly growing Sienna Plantation master-planned community. This well-maintained retail destination serves as a convenient hub for residents of one of the Houston area's most desirable neighborhoods, offering a carefully curated mix of national retailers, dining establishments, and essential services. The center's strategic location along Sienna Parkway ensures high visibility and easy accessibility for the surrounding affluent residential areas. With a strong rating of 4.4 stars from 94 reviews, The Village of Bees Creek has established itself as a trusted shopping destination where quality meets convenience. Operating daily from 9:00 AM to 10:00 PM, the center provides extended hours to accommodate the busy schedules of working families and professionals in the area.
